edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest the direction is more reliable than any single pooled magnitude.
edges.mechanism: The main pathway runs through circadian timing, arousal biology, upper-airway physiology, thermoregulation, or sympathetic activation depending on the exposure. For Sleep quality, the effect is usually strongest when the factor repeatedly disturbs sleep architecture or circadian alignment rather than acting once.
edges.summary: Cool bedroom temperature appears tied to better sleep quality in adults with insomnia symptoms mainly through pooled meta-analytic evidence. The likely magnitude is modest, which is why the edge is framed conservatively rather than as a headline-level breakthrough.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
